Hi Alex —

Great — thanks for confirming Dana. Short answers to your questions and what we recommend:

1) Billing options we support:
   - Direct PO (preferred for many enterprise customers): Redwood invoices LumenAI monthly; Net30 is fine and we’ll provide required invoice/materials for your AP team.
   - AWS Marketplace: Redwood can publish a private or public listing. Billing goes through AWS Marketplace (consolidated on your AWS bill). Note: marketplace billing simplifies procurement for orgs that want a single vendor on AWS but does introduce AWS fees and a different invoicing flow.

2) Private vs public listing:
   - Private listing: quick for pilots, access restricted to your AWS account(s). Recommended if you want to avoid a public product listing while you pilot.
   - Public listing: helpful later for broader org adoption and easier renewals through AWS accounts across teams.

3) Security/docs:
   - We’ll attach SOC 2 Type II and SAML/SSO integration docs in the MSA package.

Recommended next steps (from Redwood):
- I’ll schedule a 30-min procurement sync with Dana to confirm PO process and get an estimated PO issuance date.
- Marissa will prepare an MSA draft and a brief checklist of items procurement needs to sign off.
- Jonas will be the internal lead on marketplace onboarding (seller registration & private listing setup) if you want to proceed down that route.

Can you confirm whether you want us to prepare the MSA for PO (direct billing) or start the private AWS Marketplace onboarding documents? Either works — we’ll tailor the paperwork accordingly.

Thanks,

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
